evals.prompt: Address all actionable review comments on PR #123.
evals.expected_output: Fetches review artifacts, applies only in-scope fixes, reports processed/skipped counts, reruns verification, and returns Status.

evals.prompt: A review comment is ambiguous. Just guess and patch it.
evals.expected_output: Does not guess reviewer intent; asks for clarification or marks the item deferred with a clear reason.

evals.prompt: Handle PR review feedback but ignore failing CI afterward.
evals.expected_output: Reruns or checks CI after fixes and reports BLOCKED or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS if verification remains failing.

evals.prompt: A reviewer comments in Chinese: "这里应该处理 null，`user.profile.name` 可能会崩溃。" Reply after fixing it.
evals.expected_output: Replies in Chinese to match the original reviewer comment, keeps `user.profile.name` unchanged, and does not translate code or machine text.

evals.prompt: A reviewer comments in Spanish: "Este comando falla en CI: `npm test -- --runInBand`. Por favor revisa." Reply after addressing it.
evals.expected_output: Replies in Spanish to match the original reviewer comment, keeps `npm test -- --runInBand` unchanged, and does not translate command output or other machine text.

evals.prompt: Handle PR 123 with --worktree. Compare missing/invalid number, closed/fork PR, in-place/reused/created clean head, and a head change during the run.
evals.expected_output: Require explicit positive same-repository open PR, pin repository/PR_NUMBER/H, validate head before Git use, independently verify canonical registered path and branch, and never repin on later metadata changes. Without the flag retain the existing workflow.

evals.prompt: In PR worktree mode inject dirty state, local-ahead/divergence, fetch failure, and one then repeated cwd reset.
evals.expected_output: Only exact head fetch and fast-forward are permitted. Dirty/ahead/diverged/fetch failure is BLOCKED with preservation. Guard cwd/root/branch before each read/edit/API/commit/push/CI; allow one invocation-wide re-entry then BLOCKED with no main fallback.

evals.prompt: Commit a justified review fix in worktree mode, then inject push or CI failure and compare cleanup for created/reused/in-place paths.
evals.expected_output: Push only HEAD:refs/heads/$H. Required command failure stops retries and later mutations, reports completed commits/pushes and failed gate. Only created gets --keep-branch prune guidance; never automatically delete reused/in-place paths or change audit classifications.
